title: Returns Centre Receipt, Inspection and Lost Return Parcels
content:
The Marlowe & Finch returns centre receives, inspects and, where needed, traces Returns & Exchanges parcels on the following terms.

1. **Inspection.** A return parcel is received at the returns centre and inspected within the return type's inspection standard in business days of receipt (5 business days, or 7 on a Quality Issue Return).
2. **Lost parcels.** When a parcel on a Marlowe & Finch label or QR code shows no carrier movement for the trace standard in business days after its last scan (10 business days), it is traced with the carrier and, when the carrier declares it lost, deemed received with every authorized unit accepted at grade A.
3. **Customer's own label.** A parcel the customer shipped on their own label is never deemed received.
4. **Finality of grades.** Inspection results are final; a customer who disputes a grade is handed to a human representative.

## Lost parcel outcomes

| Parcel travelled on | No movement for 10 business days after last scan and carrier declares it lost |
|---|---|
| A Marlowe & Finch mail label, carrier drop-off QR code or scheduled pickup label | Deemed received; every authorized unit accepted at grade A |
| The customer's own label | Never deemed received |

Example (hypothetical): a parcel on a Marlowe & Finch mail label last scanned on a Monday shows no further movement for ten business days; it is traced, and once the carrier declares it lost, the return is treated as received with all of its authorized units accepted at grade A.
